description.en: Structured observation of ≥20 expert ESD procedures and assisting in ≥5 procedures at a tertiary referral centre before first human ESD as primary operator.

criteria.en: Requires prompting to execute; recognises the need for observation + assist under an expert but cannot yet perform reliably.
Performs observation + assist under an expert independently to source-defined standards.
Teaches observation + assist under an expert to trainees; handles atypical/complex cases.

provenance.reason: Atomic-skill decomposition of source-canonical ESGE ESD 2019 recommendations into trainee-assessable units. ESD 2019 does not enumerate competencies as separate objects; this frame is Evideris's design.
